description: Renovate owns every dependency in this repo. There is no Dependabot config here, so there is nothing to divide ownership with and no risk of duplicate PRs.
The add-ons pin this repo by commit SHA and track it by tag, so a dependency change here does not reach users until a release is tagged and those pins are bumped. See CLAUDE.md.

packageRules.description: One PR for all GitHub Actions rather than one per action.
